column2: The original power of the noble knights were beyond what humans can hold. With solemn denomination and loyalty to the Shadow Tribe, the black knights were the main players to be the Tribe's virtuoso.
They have been a part of the Inotian continent for a long time. With many rigorous training courses and real battle skills, they hold the strongest independent combat powers on the continent.

These wizards have been lured to the fascinating dark powers of the Shadow Tribe than of religious faith towards the church. Their practice of magic and witchcraftry is of highest destruction on the Inotian continent.

Some of the dark Shadow Followers were once devoting priests of the Life-giver, Tamit. Their distorted faith towards dark magic is more destructive than it was when they were empowered with powers of the light.
In the woods, away from most human activities, live these pursuers. Shadow Tribe members contact them to collect valuable information that provides their survival.

From the highlands, north of the Inotian continent, are a champion of savages. Some of them are mercenaries of the Shadow Tribe, not for honor or wealth, but for their strong desire to slaughter enemies in battles.

A warm and cozy bed prepared with clean sheets. Take a quick doze at a comfortable place.
Buy it or leave it. I do not sell for your advantage.
This town may be small, but everything ya' need is here. Don't think you can do better elsewhere.
I have no friends my own age, so I'm depressed.
Ow...my whole body aches with pain. The age is gettin' on me. You there, come and rub my shoulder, will ya'?
Thank you for saving me. I gotta go soon, too...&NI don't have the time to ask, but you are looking for something, right?
Thank god! The Cha-..no, ma lady has been waiting for you.
Don't know no one like that. Oh, that handsome blondie...you're not talkin' about me, maybe?
Huh? I don't know. There's no one that I don't know in this village! What brought you here? If you're bored, let's hang out!
Hm? Nope, no strangers been spotted here for a while. You seem to be confused, lad.
Berkel and Arnen's tension grows every day. This must mean war is soon to come, does it not?
Hm, an artifact? Sounds boring...son, come here and play chess with me instead?
I'm sorry, but I just don't like talking about that.
I am the healer that was with the people who were looking for the artifacts. I've never thought we'd be stuck in this village...
I told you, I don't know. Forget about it, and let's play chess, I say.
You are the stubborn one, eh? I told ya' I ain't got more to say.
Ah, the one that got mad after trying to break the seal? I'm sorry, but I don't know. The $Srummy$B at the $Rclearings$B seemed to know him well, why don't you ask him?
Maria...how can one be so cute and adorable at the same time?
Hm, I think it'll be more effective in this case, if the power is lower and the firmness is higher...
Remember, if you are vulnerable to be invaded by your violent memories, you will be chained to this place forever. Do be careful.
What do you try so hard...such a waste of energy...&NI'd give up if I were you.
It's been a while since I've seen a youngster like you around here. Sooner or later, you'd be lethargic like those fellows over there...&NThis town is that kind of place.
Let the weary souls rest…&NDo you wish to heal your wounded soul?
Steel Orc Village Mercenary Wait Area
Now, it's my turn to save you.
You are the one who can break the chain of destiny that has brought us through….
$G(I must be troubled because of $Rtoday's mission$G…)$B
$G(Anyway, a call like this must mean urgent duty...)$B
He is waiting for you in the $SForest of Shadows$B. Go to the $Reast$B.
So the scout said she was seen somewhere around here.&PShe must not be lost, you understand me? Find her!
The man barking orders is $SGrafton$B, the $REarl of the Knights of Berkel$B.&PI take it you've heard of him. The man is a celebrity.
And he has created a lot of trouble for us,&Nam I right?
Yes. It would be quite restful to know that this man cannot trouble our tribe anymore.&PI am sure that you get my meaning.
I will follow your command, Sir.
That command, you can find in the $RMenu$B, if you look at the $RQuest$B tab.
Whenever you need to check your progress, just take a look again.
You're expected to complete that one fast; I'll be waiting in the $Rcamp$B.
This place is infested with $Rsoldiers$B. &NWe need to avoid the eyes of the $REmpire$B. &PI have an idea: follow me.
I will lure them into a trap. &NYou stay here and wait for me.
You'll be alone.&PAre you sure this is worth the risk?
I will return after everything is finished.
Get it! It'll tell us where the girl is!
By the Gods above, you are not leaving this place alive.
It's killing our brothers! Smite it!
Hahahahahahaha catch me if you can!
It went over there! Seize that thing!
Was it the best decision? Maybe not.
But it's better that I am thought naive…
Rather than them knowing the truth of my intentions.
This is pathetic.&NYou thought you could hide from us in a cave?
Do not hurt her!&NShe must stay alive, at all costs, you hear me?
I think it's the other way around. Die.
$RShe$B is here.&NSearch the bushes and get her out!
$G(Okay, those aren't mine. But it's getting them too close!)$B
So you thought you could hide from us.&NYou thought you were smart.
But that's really a lame place to hide.
Aren't you cold, little one?&NYou're not wearing a lot of clothes…
You should not have left the protection of the fortification.&PWho knows what could happen to you out there…
$G($B$SShin$B$G is going to come back. I need to stall until then.)$B
Take her. But do not hurt her.&NShe's precious.
Let go of me, you know I am not to be touched.&PI will walk with you.
I find it hard to trust you on that one.&NYou just ran away, after all.
What in the Seventh Hell happened &Nwhile I turned my back?!
He was like a shadow, my Lord, &Nunstoppable…
Just one $Rboy$B, my Lord, just one.&NAnd not even in his twenties yet… A demon…
How dare you address his name like that!
...Looks like I found the right person.
Who are you?&NWho dares attack the entire Order of the Knights?
You don't exactly need to know that. &NYou're dead, anyway.
Be happy to know you're being sacrificed for $Rour tribe$B.
Oh my goodness, you killed all those people!
Whatever, I don't have time for this.
Woah, no, bad idea! &NDrop the weapon, please!
Why can no one make any sense around here?
Em…what am I supposed to say? &NYou're trying to kill me!
Are you the girl the other guy was looking for?
Well, that's putting it rather simply.
But yes, that would be me. And I fancy the idea of staying alive.
Many people sacrificed their lives for me... I cannot make their sacrifices be in vain...!&PI beg you... Please let me go... I have a mission to complete…
I fail to see why that would be my problem.
Please please please let me go.&NI can give you whatever you need.
Well, I ate enough people today and you're too skinny for my taste.
Anyway, everyone's dead, so try your best to run.
Eara, you're fine! That's a relief! &NWait a minute…You're okay, right?
I wasn't expecting to find you in the middle of corpses… But we need to go fast. &PThere are still soldiers around. Let's run.
The mission was delicate, but you have proven worthy of $Rour tribe$B. &NYou are our best $Rassassin$B.&POur tribe can live in peace, &Nat least for now.
It was an honor to serve, sir.
Good. His $RLordship$B shall bestow upon you a worthy dividend.
With this, you have evolved. &NYour $Rlevel$B has raised.
As your level goes up, your $Rstats$B and $Rskill points$B will increase. &PUse the new incentives well.
Now that you are at a high level amongst us…
I think I can let you in on how it really works here.
…For that matter, we need peace in the empire.
I am sorry to have made you wait. &NThe mass took longer than expected.
It's not a problem. &NWhy did you call for me?
This is neither the time nor the place to talk of it. &PLet's go to my $Roffice$B where we can talk freely.
I trust you have been well, Kiyan?
And I am happy that you made it as $RVirtuoso$B. Our tribe and the people need agile hands like yours.&PAre you ready to serve our cause?
Yes, Cardinal.&PWhat would my assignment be?
Have you heard about the recent abduction of the $RChannel$B?
A berkelan woman so precious that they thought we took her.
Berkel is almost sure to win the war, &Nand even $Rthe Highests$B cannot protect us. &PThe people of the Shadow Tribe must stop a war from erupting.&PWe will $Rrescue$B the Channel.

The Channel is being sent a $RRescue Team$B as we speak; the knights of Berkel will soon be on their way. &PDisguise as one of them and she will follow you, thinking you are her protector. &PThis is your mission.

You might feel strange since this Channel is a true child of $RTamit$B, the god they call the $RLife-Giver$B. &PBut this, we have to do. &N$SPortia$B will give you the details. &PMay your hand and your spirit carry the honor of our tribe, Kiyan.
I will not disappoint you, Cardinal sir.
The time has come to execute our&N$Rplan$B.
Yes. The great dark powers of $RMoar$B will lead your steps. &PAllure them to that place. &NDo whatever you need to lead them there.
Yes, my Lord! &NYou will not regret this. &PI will follow the orders to the fullest.
But, remember. &NThey must not know of our $Rreasons$B. Never.
Haha! My Lord! &NYou seem to be too worried. Just watch me work.
Let's go, Goshak. &NIt's time for us to play.
Ok, I'll bring along a shovel. &NYou bring the bucket.
All this chaos will gradually lead to &Nthe revival of $RMoar$B…

Your $Rdisguise$B is almost ready. &NThis will give you the perfect look of a $RBerkel Knight$B. &PBut we still need reagents for the spell to be complete. &PGo to the deepests of the $RShadow  Training Dungeon2$B and fetch these $Rreagents$B and some $Rectoplasms$B, will you? &PAbout $R5$B of them will do.
Wait. I will work the magic.
Are you ready? &PWait, you need to check the new equipment you wore, it's safer. &PIn the $REquipment Menu$B, you will see your $Rgear$B. &NTake this...
You may look like a knight, but it will still be very perilous to infiltrate the Berkel army. &PYou won't be alone, you will get $Rhelp$B.
The best way to get support for you is to hire mercenaries. Those who can be put at risk with minimum danger for yourself. &PI'll teach you how to hire them.
Ah, right, I promised to tell you about the $Rmercenaries$B.
All right, then I believe you are ready. &NTake this.
This letter of recommendation must be delivered to $SLehman$B, the leader of the Channel's Rescue Team.&PThey are at $RHanun Forest$B.
If you succeed with this plan, you will have done good for our tribe. &PThen, good luck.
Don't worry. He has learned from the best and he is, currently, the best.
And everything he does is for our tribe. That's why we're here, you know.
Why haven't we heard anything from them?
They are way past the scheduled time! &PHow are we going to get the Channel if no one can organize?! &NIncompetent idiots…
Kiyan, the apprentice. &NI come with a recommendation from Cardinal Janus.
Yes, he did. Please, have a look.
Fine. You're in. &PBut with no Rescue Team and $Rwizard$B to inspect the $Sleap-gate$B, the operation is not launching yet. &PYou will have to wait.
Well, frankly, you can be of immediate use to me. &PGo find Wizard $SGrumman$B. He's a bit lost, but you should find him wandering around in the woods.
What in the name of the Goddess is going on here?!
It wasn't that hard, was it? &NWhen I asked for two platoons of soldiers?! &PWhy are there less than ten?
Sergeant Lehman, don't make a fuss.
Soooo you're trying to rescue our precious Channel with a handful of men? &PDon't you think you might need more people for that?
I did ask for two platoons of soldiers, &NCommander. I wonder where they are now.
Well, it seems that we are understaffed everywhere. The templars are in the same situation. &PIt isn't surprising that they would send only a few of theirs.
And you, Sergeant, really should not complain. &PEspecially since your wife doesn't know that you don't actually play poker on Friday nights.
Commander Alexander, surely you don't mean that…
I command the $RKnights of Berkel$B. &PDo you have any problem with this, Sergeant?
I thought so...Let's see… &PWith only this many soldiers, it might be difficult to rescue the Channel.
But it's going to be a fun challenge.
Let's see how well you do….or not.
What is going on? Who is this person?

$RCommander Alexander$B leads the $RKnights of Berkel$B. &NHe is under direct orders of his Holiness, like the five other force leaders. &PSadly, he is impossible to bypass. &NWe have to suck up to him, no matter how hard it is.
Anyway, the Channel's rescue must begin soon. As soon as possible, for that matter. &PSo collect your spirits, and see me when you are ready.
Grumman, are you done with the preparations?
Let me just memorize the order leading us to the leap-gate.
I trust you. Let's go, then.

You're here. Now, let me explain to you more about the mission. &PWe heard from the scouts that the Channel is trapped deep inside of Arnen Castle. &PFrom there, you will save her, bring her to this $Rleap-gate$B so she can return to the Empire. &PIf something happens, go $Rsouth$B to the $Remergency leap-gate$B, that's at the $Rnorth of Kamuran Village$B.
Let's move, men! &NThe Channel is to be saved!
This quietness gets on my nerves. &NSuch a grand place, so empty…
It feels like a trap, sir.
Maybe it's a trap, but we don't have a choice, do we? &PEven if it's a trap, we must find the Channel.
Do you hear that? There's a sound coming from down below…
Degenerate Berkel Empire dogs…&NHow dare you come to our door!
They will not leave this place alive. &NBlood must be spilled for this insult.
For the Channel, for Berkel, fight! &NWe must finish the mission, whatever the risk!
Kiyan, there's too many of them to fight on your own. &PGet the front, and while the rest of the guys have energy, reduce their number to give us a better chance!
There's always more, we're getting tired…
They're too many. I'll hold them off here, you go get the Channel. &PYou will not spare your effort. Do everything you can to bring her back!
And you are… the insufferable prick.
Did you just call me insufferable?
Didn't you say I was too skinny? &NAn eye for an eye.
And $Rthe Channel$B is a person like you. &NGreat.
I don't see how that would be your problem.
Besides, why are you dressed up like a knight? &PTrying to hide the tattoos? Do you have remorse over a past life or is this just a disguise?
I'd have to be in danger to need $Rrescuing$B.
You are in danger; there is not time for banter. For now, let's get the hell out of here.
You said you're a knight. &NDo you take me for an idiot? I don't buy it. &PI could pretend I believe your lame lie and kill you when your guard is down.
In which case I am putting my life in danger for just the sake of curiosity. &NI am not stupid.
People are killing themselves out here for you, and that the fight will eventually get to you. &PI belong to neither team, so I am getting you out of here. I am, actually, your best bet.
Are you sure you need the time to think? Because I am pretty certain that they are on my heels. &PYou'll have to choose: life or death?
You said you don't belong to $RBerkel$B, and you're not of the $RShadow Tribe$B. &PWho are you really?
I'm afraid it is. &PI ran away from the Empire, and I won't go back.
Good. I'm not taking you back there.
I don't think you plan to rescue me either. &PI am planning to become an $Rexile$B and live what's left of my life out of their reach.
$G(Can I really believe that?) &P(...But come to think of it...she did seem to be chased by the Empire troops that time...)$B
The Empire, and the Church, have used my name to justify the killing of endless number of innocents. &PI cannot condone that.
And for that reason, maybe, your help will be appreciated.
But your incentive is not clear enough, and I will not follow you. &NYou have not convinced me.
$G(This situation is absurd. What to do?)$B
The Channel is this way! Get her!
$G(Already? Should I force her to follow me? But I was ordered not to hurt her…)$B&NIf you're not cooperating, then this is the only way.
I didn't want to come to this, but you leave me with no other choice.
My life is worth more than hers. &NI have to leave before they force their way in.
Kiyan, I see you got the Channel. &NGood job.
But, why is she unconscious? &NWhat happened?
…Nothing, sir. She didn't eat enough. &NThat's all.
….I see. Now since you have her, hurry up and go.
These rascals have kidnapped the Channel! Get them!
It seems like there's always more! &NWhere on earth do they come from?!
Kiyan! We need to get her out of there! &NTake the Channel to the leap-gate! Move!
Sergeant, you should go! I will protect you!
We're outnumbered, by far. &NTake care of the Channel, I will make sure that the two of you make a safe exit. &PNow, go! This is an order!
I don't get it. Something's wrong…
Now, you bastard. &NYou dare lay your hands on her.
$G(He's the one who killed all the soldiers?)$B
By the Goddess, you are an it. &NYou're a $Rfey$B!
I am $SShin$B, the Channel's $Rescort and protector$B.
And this is the last time that I am requesting for you to let go of her.
I have no intention of doing so. You see, I am her new protector. You lost her, I got her. &PNow step aside.
You know I'm gonna kill you if you don't hand her to me. Unharmed, of course.
$G(So the fey training is different, all right.) &P(You have some good moves. But that's not going to be enough to defeat me.)$B
I see you having a hard time.
All right, you do have some skills.&NBut that's not enough.
I will make dust out of your eyeballs.
Step back! Her life is in danger if you don't step back this instant!
Is that how you protect her?
Listen, I'm going to make this clear for your small fey ears. &PI don't like you. If you make one more step forward, I will $Rkill$B this woman. Channel or not. Is this clear?
Oh yeah, very clear. You're a coward who would attack a defenseless woman.
…Like she's a damsel in distress. &NYou read too many mushy novels.
So what is your decision? &NYou leave, or she dies?
You know what, human? I hate you.
I will be one step behind you. I will stalk you until you are dead and she is back with me.
You're the one who's creating danger for her. &P$G(I should go to the emergency $B$Rleap-gate$B$G at the $B$Rnorth side of Kamuran Village$B$G.)$B
Takes one to know one, fey.
And I'm sorry, but I'm not letting you through. You'll have to fight me.
You really think that you're stronger than me?
Gods above, you really are annoying. &NGet out of the way!
I don't really care about your opinion, blondie.
Woah! I didn't do that one for a long time! It feels nice!
You have more power than one like you should ever be allowed to have.
Yeah, say that to my genitors. &NThey're really proud of me.
Upon those niceties, blondie, I'm leaving. It was nice meeting you.
Have you lost the rest of the crew? &NWhy are you here?
Speak, now. Are you disobeying commands of the Kingdom?
$G(Nothing more is need to be said. Die.)$B
Hm…I guess it's not possible to enter without making any fuss.
I am a follower of the Shadow Tribe.
An infidel! How dare you defile this place with your presence!
